nitroxanalyser.changelog: Adds label inversion and calculation-bar visibility controls, automatic selection for verified NIIMBOT stock, and a saved hypoxic warning threshold (0.18 bar default). Red is used only below the selected oxygen threshold; normal labels remain black/white. Inverted red bands now align with the black artwork edges. Fixes the Stay Connected web setting. Update-only installation retains licence, calibration and settings.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Adds label inversion, independent MOD/END/bar visibility, optional gas density at MOD, and a saved hypoxic warning threshold (0.18 bar default). Verified RFID stock is selected automatically; red highlights are reserved for hypoxic gas. Inverted red bands align with the black artwork edges. Adds an optional local read-only analysis API, disabled by default. Experimental Bluetooth app transport is excluded. Existing licences and settings are retained by update-only installation.
